name: ApplyPendingMigrations
transaction_boundary: one explicit atomic transaction per pending migration; clean initialization uses an unpublished temporary keyed database until full verification succeeds
guards: all accepted migration bytes/hash/order verified before mutation
database is not unsupported future schema
each migration begins from exact expected prior sequence
idempotency: migration sequence/id/hash ledger determines exact applied state; already-applied exact migration is no-change, drift/mismatch fails closed
receipt_order: migration ledger is specialized technical evidence; per migration: keyed/verified connection -> BEGIN IMMEDIATE -> execute parsed statements individually -> insert exact schema_migrations row -> COMMIT -> post-verification
mutations: schema objects owned by allocated migration
unpublished clean-init database before atomic publication
revision_effects: schema migration sequence advances exactly one per committed migration; no domain lifecycle revision is fabricated
audit_action: none; immutable migration ledger/manifest is governing technical evidence per audit/actions.json
post_commit_work: after final migration run exact release-schema verification; publish new clean-init database only after all checks pass
